<title level="1" right="Class Feature 3">[Root Epithet](/Classes.aspx?ID=65)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 28

**Class** Exemplar
</column>

---

As your story unfolds, your personality and deeds begin to shape the potential of your divine spark. You come to bear an epithet—a word or phrase that seems to always stick in the mind of those describing you. Your epithets grant you additional abilities, especially when your divine spark is brought to the surface.

 You first gain a root epithet to describe an aspect of your personality. This grants you a skill, as well as a special effect that occurs when you Spark Transcendence. If you are already trained in the granted skill, you become trained in a different skill of your choice, as normal. An effect that occurs after you Spark Transcendence happens immediately after your transcendence action is completely resolved. Choose one [Root Epithet.](Epithets.aspx?Type=Root)
name: Root Epithet
